children: Phio submitted a comprehensive briefing package to the FDA for PH-762 and plans a Phase 2b neoadjuvant study after completing Phase 1b.
Submitted meeting request and comprehensive briefing package to the FDA to support next clinical stage for PH-762.
Briefing package details nonclinical program, integrated clinical pharmacology and completed Phase 1b study data.
Company proposes a planned Phase 2b neoadjuvant study in cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma to follow Phase 1b.
Preparing clinical supply manufacture; supplies expected to be available in Q1 2027 to support the next study.
Nonclinical toxicology dosing phase completed; final activities for next phase expected to finish in Q1 2027.
